newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end quiet session higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end quiet session higher.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures finished the quiet session higher and amid tight ranges.
September Standard and Poor's 500 futures ended near the top of an extremely tight range, posting an inside day on daily bar charts that technicians said was a sign on consolidation.

September's gains pulled the contract farther from two-week lows set on Monday and above support from 664.40 to 666.00. September posted a session high of 667.25, with resistance now seen at Monday's Globex peak at 669.00 and at the 1-1/2 month high settlement of 671.85.
Further resistance lurks at 672.55, the 1-1/2 month high set last Thursday.
"It was fairly quiet," an S&P 500 futures trader said.

According to the Redbook Retail Sales Index, U.S. adjusted retail sales for the first three weeks in August rose 0.9 percent compared with July. Treasury's two-year note auction was deemed slightly disappointing by other traders, but auction results had scant impact on stocks.
U.S. sold $18.752 billion in two-year notes at an average high yield of 6.170 percent. The bid-to-cover ratio was at 2.23 and non-competitive bods totalled $1.52 billion.
Earlier in the session, gains had been capped by a strong U.S. consumer confidence reading. U.S. consumer confidence rose to a new six-year high of 109.4 in August from a revised 107.0 in July.

Traders also noted brisk sales earlier of 1,500 to 2,000 contracts at 666.00 that kept gains in check. They said the selling came from five brokerage houses, much like selling seen last week at 672.00.
In late trading, a 667.00 to 666.50 range held September S&P 500s, "with no real players and no volume," another S&P trader said.
Floor chartists said September was well-supported all day.

"From a technical standpoint 667.20 was a pretty key level and they got a quarter print," one trader said. "If they can get through that (667.25) the next big technical area is 669.05 to 669.20," he said.

September S&P 500 futures closed up 2.50 points to 666.70, Nikkei 225 futures rose 90.0 points to 20,945.0, Russell 2000 futures posted an 3.10-point gain to 334.30, NYSE Composite index rose 1.35 points to 357.40, Value Line gained 4.75 points to 623.80 and MidCap 400 rose 1.75 to 234.00. -Derivatives Desk, (312)408-8750;E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
